t: Mi shennizdammen lo ruach bitpillato o ittush
s: Mi shennizdammen lo ruach bitpillato o ittush ubo g' seipim: haya omed bitpilla veyatza mimmennu ruach millematta — mamtin ad sheyyikleh (haruach) [hareach] vechozer lammaqom sheppasaq:

Biqqesh latzet mimmennu ruach millematta venitztaer harbeh veeno yakol lehaamid atzmo — holek laachorayv d' ammot umotzi haruach. Velo yelek litzdadim, mippene shetztzarik sheyyihyu panayv mekuvvanim keneged hammaqom shehitchil lehitpallel, shello yehe nireh keposeq legamre veen kavvanato lachazor litpillato. Umamtin ad sheyyikleh hareach veomer: "ribbon haolamim, yetzartanu neqabim neqabim, chalulim chalulim, galuy veyadua lepaneka cherpatenu ukelimmatenu, cherpa ukelimma bechayyenu, rimma vetolea bemotenu", veen amira zo chashub hepseq battepilla, hoil ukebar mupseqet tepillato al yede haruach, vechozer limqomo, vechozer lammaqom sheppasaq. Velo yigmor tepillato bammaqom shennitracheq sham, hoil ukebar hitchil lehitpallel kan veqoba hashshekina maqom kan, ukeshebbiqqesh lehitattesh nitracheq mimmeqom hashshekina, lepikak tzarik hu lachazor lammaqom sheqqaba lashshekina. Veakshav lo nahagu apillu hamdaqdeqim leharchiq d' ammot velomar "ribbon veku'". Veyesh shellimmedu zekut lomar shello hitzriku leharchiq ella keshemmitpallel bebeto, abal keshemmitpallel betzibbur shezzeh lo bizzayon gadol shennireh lakkol boshto ukelimmato — eno tzarik leharchiq kelal, sheggadol kebod habberiyyot. Vekevan sheen tzarik leharchiq, en lomar gam ken "ribbon ku'", kevan sheen cherpato ukelimmato nikkeret, raq mamtin ad sheyyikleh hareach. Vekol zeh kesheeno yakol lehaamid atzmo, abal im yakol — chayyab lehaamid atzmo bekol mah deepshar shello lehapiach battepilla, veen bazeh mishshum "bal teshaqqetzu". Vaapillu im nitzrak linqabayv — yaamid atzmo kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tz"b:

Hammitattesh bitpillato millematta, apillu hapacha muetet sheenah mashmaat qol — siman ra lo, milmala — siman yapeh lo, shekkeshem sheosin lo nachat ruach millematta shehaittush hu noach laadam — kak osin lo nachat ruach milmala lemalloot sheelato ubaqqashato:
